Greetings Minister Renegrade,

Thank you for your warm and thoughtful letter. We eagerly await the arrival of Captain Butcher and the RSN Enterprise at the port of Hastings; our harbour authorities and storehouses stand fully prepared to execute our raw material agreement without delay.

Regarding your proposal on dyes: as you know, colouring is an exceptionally vital commodity for county operations and prestige production. Given its strategic significance, I must first consult with our Sheriff, Lord Egor Llewellynn, regarding our reserve thresholds. Once we review our stockpiles together, I am confident we can return to the table and conclude an advantageous accord for regular dye shipments.

Your remarks regarding our governance and shared ideals resonate deeply with me. Establishing close and enduring relations with Glasgow—and most especially with the noble Selçuklu Family—is an immensely positive development, both for the County Palatine of Sussex and for the Welsh Nationalist Party, which I have the honour to lead.

We view Glasgow as a steadfast partner, and I welcome the prospect of future passenger routes and broader mutual cooperation with great optimism. May these first commercial steps pave the way for a lasting fellowship between our realms.

With highest regards and respect,


Trade Minister of Sussex
Supervisor for the Welsh Nationalist Party

Docking request accepted.
Welcome to Hastings!

Greetings,
Peter
